description: `python predict.py linear-eval --task rigid|affine [--tta none|flip8] [--tta-levels L]`: rigid / affine errors against seeded synthetic misalignments of any processed dataset (design 7.3), paired across TTA arms by the seed; outputs per_subject.csv, per_pair.csv, summary.json, tta_spread.csv. Depends on FEAT-002 (StreamedRunner tta, _setup_tta, tta_spread writer).
steps: 1. inference/cli.py: `_common(p, default_branches, chunk_defaults, branches=True)` (no --branches flag when False); new subparser `linear-eval` (help 'rigid / affine errors against seeded synthetic misalignments (design 7.3)'): _common(l, None, RUN_CHUNK_DEFAULTS, branches=False), `--task {rigid,affine}` required, `--seed` int >= 0 default 0, `--tta {none,flip8}`, `--tta-levels`, `--store {auto,ram,disk}`, `--store-dir`, `--out` (directory) required, `--overwrite`. Keep `--label-name` (subject discovery). validate(): for linear-eval set args.branches = args.task, args.mode = 'streamed', reuse the --out directory checks with LINEAR_EVAL_OUTPUTS = ('per_subject.csv', 'per_pair.csv', 'summary.json', 'tta_spread.csv') for the overwrite protection, the --tta-levels-without-flip8 error, and store-dir check. TF-free.

2. New inference/linear_eval.py (docstring citing design 7.3 and the ground-truth caveat): LINEAR_EVAL_KEYS (status, message, command, git_commit, git_commit_source, configure_device, checkpoint, model_config, precision, task, seed, ranges, n_subjects, subjects, subject_dirs, levels, tta, tta_record, store, chunks, timing_s, gpu_peak_mb, means, p95, nonfinite, note, outputs, grid, input_range, warnings, visible_devices, device); NOTE = 'errors include the residual alignment of the processed subjects'; `run_linear_eval(args, configure_device=True)` -> exit code via predict._command_wrapper(..., path=<out>/summary.json, kind='linear-eval summary.json'). Body: setup_device; peek = predict._peek_config; plan = predict._setup_levels (branches = task); tta_cfg = predict._setup_tta; subjects via predict._read_subjects (labels unused, freed); n < 2 -> PredictError(2); grid must be the level-1 shape (else PredictError(2)); m = (mean_i 1[I_i > 0]) >= 0.5, S = tfm.brain_second_moment(m, 1.0); T, T_target = fixed_data.random_linear_transforms(np.random.default_rng(seed), N, task) (ranges recorded = dict(params.DEFAULT_LINEAR_RANGES[task])); rendered = fixed_data.render_group(images[..., None], T, P.LEVEL_SPACING[1], chunk=2); free images; A_star = tfm.barycentric_targets(tf.constant(T_target), 10).numpy(); load via predict._load; store via estimate_store_gb(level, model_cfg, n, task, tdt) + choose_store (store_dir = args.store_dir or $TMPDIR or <out>/_stream_tmp); StreamedRunner(loaded, store, chunks, plan=plan, tta=tta_cfg).run(rendered, task) in try/finally store.close(); A = summary['A'] float64; non-finite A -> rec status 'nonfinite', exit 3 (CSV not written); errs = runtime.metrics.group_errors(A, A_star, T_target, S, affine=task == 'affine'); per_subject.csv: subject, subject_dir, center_rms_mm, center_rot_deg, center_trans_mm, [center_scale_pct, center_shear_pct], pair_rms_mm_mean (mean over pairs with the subject as moving image, via runtime.metrics.all_ordered_pairs index i); per_pair.csv: moving, fixed, pair_rms_mm, pair_rot_deg, pair_trans_mm, [pair_scale_pct, pair_shear_pct]; tta_spread.csv with TTA (shared writer from predict.py, FEAT-002); summary.json: means and p95 of every error array, cycle_rms_mm mean, seed, ranges, note, tta, tta_record, timing (read, render, model, metrics), gpu_peak_mb, outputs. csv via the stdlib csv module.

3. predict.py (root): dispatch `linear-eval` -> `from inference import linear_eval as LE; return LE.run_linear_eval(args, configure_device=True)`; update the module docstring usage block. inference/__init__.py docstring: `linear_eval` bullet. inference/predict.py: factor the tta_spread.csv writer into `write_tta_spread(path, rows, subs)` if FEAT-002 has not already (both commands use it).

4. tests/test_linear_eval.py (imports tests.tf_setup first): setUpClass writes 3 textured phantoms (tests.predict_helpers.write_subjects(proc, 3, textured=True, seed=21)) and a tiny level-4 checkpoint (save_level4_run) and the level-2 cascade checkpoint (construction as tests/test_predict.py TestLevel2Convention). Tests: rigid and affine at level 4 with --tta none and --tta flip8 -> exit 0; per_subject.csv has 3 rows and the documented columns (affine adds scale/shear), per_pair.csv 6 rows, summary.json key set == LINEAR_EVAL_KEYS, note text, seed 0, finite means; the rendered inputs are identical across arms (patch fixed_data.render_group with a wrapper recording a sha256 of its output, or call the module's render helper twice) ; tta_spread.csv only with flip8 (rows = 3 subjects x levels); level-2 cascade affine flip8 exit 0 with rows for levels 4 and 2; < 2 subjects (subjects file with one entry) -> exit 2 with summary.json status error; --tta-levels without flip8 -> SystemExit 2; existing outputs without --overwrite -> exit 2.
5. Write .agents/tasks/tta/test-log-FEAT-003.md (commands, results, counts, timings of the flip8 runs).
acceptance_criteria: tests.test_linear_eval passes (both tasks, both arms, level 4 and level 2, error cases).
tests.test_predict and tests.test_predict_tta still pass (run / check-streaming CLI unchanged; validate imports no TF).
Same --seed gives bit-identical rendered inputs in both TTA arms (asserted).
summary.json carries the residual-alignment note, the seed, the ranges and tta_record.
